方向移动 · A 确认／编辑 · B 返回 · LB／RB 切换区域: D-pad to move · A to confirm/edit · B to go back · LB/RB to switch regions
横坐标需按从小到大排列，且所有值都需有效。: X coordinates must be in ascending order and all values must be valid.
选择映射使用的接口。需要体感时，请选择标有「体感可用」的接口。: Choose an interface for mapping. For motion input, select one marked Gyro available.
上次选择的接口 · 等待连接: Previously selected interface · Waiting for connection
暂无可访问的体感接口。请检查第三方接管模式及 HidHide 读取权限。: No accessible gyro interface. Check third-party takeover mode and HidHide access permissions.
此接口未报告扩展按键。: This interface reports no extra buttons.
开始观察后显示实时输入。: Start monitoring to see live input.
在组件页检测驱动和管理实体手柄可见性。: Check drivers and manage physical controller visibility on the Components page.
调整中 · 左右微调，上下 10 步: Adjusting · Left/right for fine steps, up/down for 10 steps
启用当前配置并继续游戏: Enable this profile and continue playing
继续游戏后停止界面导航。在窗口前台按 View + Menu 可暂停映射并切回手: Continuing the game stops interface navigation. With this window in front, press View + Menu to pause mapping and return to controller navigation.
每份游戏配置都可以导出为 TOML 文件。: Each game profile can be exported as a TOML file.
标准手柄按键和摇杆自动映射，可添加键鼠动作。: Standard buttons and sticks are mapped automatically; you can add keyboard/mouse actions.
用手柄操作游戏中的键盘与鼠标动作。: Use the controller for keyboard and mouse actions in games.
当前体感使用虚拟右摇杆。切换到键鼠前，请在「体感调校」将体感输出改为鼠标或关闭体: Gyro currently uses a virtual right stick. Before switching to keyboard/mouse output, choose mouse gyro output or disable gyro in Gyro tuning.
当前手柄可以录入触摸板按下。: This controller supports recording a touchpad click.
选择带触摸板按键的手柄接口后，即可验证点按输入。: Select a controller interface with a touchpad button to test click input.
虚拟 DualShock 4 会自动映射实体手柄的触摸板按键。: Virtual DualShock 4 automatically maps the physical touchpad button.
可以添加触摸板点按动作。: You can add touchpad click actions.
{0} 自动映射已就绪，可添加额外键鼠动作。: {0} automatic mapping is ready. You can add keyboard/mouse actions.
自动映射已就绪，可添加额外键鼠动作。: Automatic mapping is ready. You can add keyboard/mouse actions.
添加第一个动作，例如“跳跃 → 空格 → A”。: Add your first action, such as Jump → Space → A.
点击已绑定的手柄控件可编辑动作。: Click a bound controller control to edit its action.
也可以直接点击表格中的键鼠操作或手柄输入开始录入。: You can also click a keyboard/mouse binding or controller input in the table to record it.
方向键或左摇杆移动，A 打开文件夹或选择文件，B 返回。支持 UTF-8、UTF: Use the D-pad or left stick to move, A to open a folder or select a file, and B to go back. Supports UTF-8, UTF-16 and Chinese ANSI text.
此文件夹没有可选的配置文件。: No supported configuration files in this folder.
